title: Persona-driven QuickWalks: cost-sensitive rollout sandbox
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Design a set of persona-driven QuickWalks (3 short interactive flows) surfaced inside the Redwood Console sandbox that teach teams how to do low-risk rollout experiments while keeping cost visibility front-and-center. Each QuickWalk is a compact, actionable micro-tutorial targeting a different persona: Platform Engineer (setup dedicated capacity), Product PM (canary rollout + metric check), and Developer (local sandbox + cost preview). The flows should live in empty states and the sandbox project starter, include inline tooltips and small templates, and surface estimated token and GPU cost before users run a job.
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct QuickWalk flows (Platform Engineer, Product PM, Developer) designed and annotated
Prototypes linked and playable in Figma/ProtoPie with realistic data and cost preview calculations
Copy reviewed by content and legal for clarity and no overpromising
Accessibility checks (color contrast, keyboard nav) completed
Design handoff tokens and redlines uploaded to the Design System repo and ENG backlog created
design_notes: Keep each flow under 90 seconds to respect developer time-to-value
Cost preview shows estimated token and GPU-minute ranges, not exact billing — include explanatory microcopy
Use progressive disclosure in the empty state: show 1 primary action and 1 secondary learning action
Avoid modal-heavy patterns; prefer embedded stepper in the sandbox canvas
Trade-off: tighter copy vs. completeness — prefer concise steps with links to full docs
Consider rollout safety pattern: preflight checklist that is lightweight and non-blocking
